test_title: PYST 37: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 20 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in closest integral ₹) on ₹3,000 at 6% per annum rate of interest for the period from 9 February 2024 to 10 April 2024.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹3,000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6% per annum

Time (T) = From 9 February 2024 to 10 April 2024

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100} 

**Calculation:**

Time (T) = Total days from 9 February 2024 to 10 April 2024

February 2024 = 29 days (leap year), days left = 29 - 9 + 1 = 21
